generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The declaration by the bidder in the letter head that none of their contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of their default in KPCL or elsewhere during last ten years. This should be neatly typed in the letter head and signed by the bidder.

The declaration by the bidder in the letter head that their offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. This should be neatly typed in the letter head and signed by the bidder.

The declaration by the bidder in the letter head that I have studied the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that I have submitted the bid having studied understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement. This should be neatly typed in the letter head and signed by the bidder.

The bidder shall furnish copies of the following statutory documents, Income tax PAN, GST registration certificate,Labour license certificate,Local police verification of labours is in contract scope to be accepted

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT AND SAME SHALL BE UPLOAD

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The bidder shall have carried out supply/erection of UG LT cable and as proof of the above, a copy of work order cum Work completion certificate worth of not less than Rs 27.50 lakhs executed in single work order in any one of the preceding Five years. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 and 2025-26) As a proof of this the bidder shall upload work order and relevant work done certificate issued by an officer of the rank of Chief Engineer / Competent authority. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

The bidder shall be a Class-II or above electrical contractor. As a proof of this, valid Electrical license issued by Govt. of Karnataka shall be furnished As a proof, the bidder shall furnish the copy of same. In case Electrical contractor possess a valid Electrical License issued by the any other State government shall be endorsed by Government of Karnataka. As a proof, the bidder shall upload endorsed copy of the same along with the bid

The bidder shall have minimum average annual turnover of Rs 55 Lakhs in any two of preceding five years. (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 and 2025-26) As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload copies of turnover certificate or profit & losses statement duly certified by chartered accountant.( Financial turnover for previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited)

3 1/2 Core 70 sqmm size [ sub LP cables]
3 1/2 Core 95 sqmm size [ main cables]
Labour charges for laying of 1.1kv class UG cable in existing trench/ GI Pipe/ stone ware pipe/ on wall/on pole as required -2.5 to 25 Sqmm
35 sqmm to 95sqmm
120 to 240 Sqmm
Supplying GI pipe ISI make only-GI Pipe - 25 mm Dia
GI Pipe - 50 mm Dia
Supply and laying of RCC Hume Pipe 2000 mm long 200 mm Dia

Supplying & Fixing moulded case circuit breaker over existing wood /panel board using necessary screws, bolts, nuts necessary phase separators handle and wiring complete. Protection of overload and short circuit thermal magnetic/Micro processor release and earth fault as per IS 13947 Four Pole 3 phase 4 pole 100 amps
Four pole - 3 phase 4 pole 200 amps

Supplying & Fixing regular MCCB distribution penal confirm to IS 8828, on wall / wood board / flush mounting using required clamps, bolt & nut etc., with provision for fixing of suitable type capacity MCCB's as an incomer for 3 phase, double door with necessary bus bar completely wired to use on 440 volts 3 phase 4 wire powder coated painting etc., complete with a provision for 3 phase suitable capacity MCCB / MCB's as out goings confirm to IS:8828 out door type dust proof / water proof, and copper bus bar with heavy duty cable glands Suitable for UG cable of 1.1 kv class etc., complete.8way[ SLP+ MLP]

Earth work excavation for pipelines/cables by Manual means up to 600 mm trench width, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or leveling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m. Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering and lift up to 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage& other appurtenances required to complete the work.-In all kinds of soil.
Supplying & Fixing angle iron frame work fabricated out of MS angle iron & MS flat bolts, washers etc., & painted with 2 coats of red oxide and 2 coats of approved paint. -50 X 50 X 6 mm MS angle

Fabricating, supplying & erecting swaged tubular pole of height 9 mtrs having three sections and providing 2 coats of red oxide paint and finished with 2 coats of enameled paint approved quality and colour. And MS base plate of suitable size welded at the bottom of the pole [as per IS] 40 mm dia GI/ Flexible PVC pipe of one meter length fitted to the heavy gauge polycarbonate control box including 5 way connector of size 167 X 125 X 82 mm for 7.5M pole-200X160X98mm for remaining length of pole with front opening cover, with locking arrangements & suitable capacity MCB / DP switch the pole shall be erected in cement concrete work [1:2:4] including excavation and refilling planting of depth of the pole to the ground level and coping CC shall be up to 0.6 mtr. above grand level as per IS-2713-7.9mt [5m Hb, 165.1mm dia 4.85mm thick X 2 m Hm, 139.7mm dia4.50mm thick X 2 mt. Ht, 114.3 mm dia 3.65mm thick] as per IS-410 SP32

Supplying & Fixing of Hot dip galvanized MS Bracket suitable for out door luminaries & mounted on Octagonal pole using necessary bolts ,nuts etc, complete. Single Arm bracket with 2000mm Standard 40/50 mm dia

Wiring for lighting /power circuit using one of FRLS PVC insulated 1100 V grade, multi-strand Copper wire with low conductor resistance single core in open or concealed system of wiring as per IS-694 & confirming to latest amendments[1.5sqmm]

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for leveling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.1.Mix 1:5:10 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Supplying, fixing, Wiring, earth electrode for grounding conduits, I.C. cutouts and other equipment's on the meter board using 40mm dia 2.90mm thick GI Pipe 2.5mtr long buried in a pit…The pit should be filled with equal proportion of salt and charcoal 150mm all-round the pipe to complete depth. The connection from the pipe to the conduit etc., is to be established through GI Wire of size as per ISI specification 7.3.3. of IS 732 using 12mm dia bolts, nuts, washers and check nut etc., the pipe shall have 16 through holes of 122mm dia
Burnt bricks [Class 35 Modular, bricks]

Supplying and filling in plinth foundations / UG cable work with approved M-sand including watering, ramming, consolidating and dressing. The rate includes the cost of material, labour charges, required tools and plants etc., complete. Work shall be carried out as per the instructions of Engineer- in-charge of works as per the standard procedure.
Route & joint indicating slab with MS anchor rods,[ for every 15mtrs intervals.]
Fixing of route and joint indicating slab
Covering of Cables by Tiles/bricks
Dismantling of PCC / RCC poles

Stringing of conductor Squirrel, Weasel, binding of conductor on each insulator and dead ending on strain or disc/strain insulator by means of clamps. (Dismantling of ACSR Rabbit/ Weasel / Squirrel conductor.)
